name: synapse-graph-skills
description: File-based engineering memory for solo full-stack developers — graph-topology context loading with seamless auto-record (session end) and auto-prefetch (user prompt submit). Zero pip/npm dependencies.

synapse-graph-memory.description: Core memory engine — retrieval protocol, bounded BFS link tracing, SQLite FTS5 cache, prefetch_context (read side), auto_observe + session-end hook (write side), Memory Inbox, Project Resume.
new_in_1.5: hardened session-end.sh (interpreter discovery, empty-array guards, SessionEnd event)

synapse-timeline.description: Read-only timeline and open issues query. Parses Change Log and Open Issues from memory nodes with filtering by tag, date, and node.

synapse-daily-note.description: NL-to-memory write pipeline — ingest, edge suggestions, apply, MAP rebuild, doctor validation.

synapse-init.description: Cold-start wizard. Auto-detects tech stack, infers module boundaries, generates skeleton nodes, copies helper scripts, and registers host hooks.

host_adapters.contract: Adapters normalize host lifecycle events only; memory policy lives in the shared scripts.

hosts.agents-md: managed instruction section for AGENTS.md-spec hosts: codex, gemini-cli, pi, zed, opencode, cursor

build.single_source: synapse-graph-memory/scripts/ is canonical; dependent skills receive synced copies via scripts/build_dist.py (see scripts/dist-manifest.json). CI enforces with `build_dist.py --check`.

compatibility.python_deps: stdlib only (json, re, sys, datetime, pathlib, sqlite3, ast)
compatibility.other_hosts: codex cli, gemini cli, pi, zed, opencode, cursor, generic (via adapters)

eval_results.provenance_note: Only the v1.0 table is backed by recorded eval runs. The v1.2 performance and v1.4 accuracy figures elsewhere in the README are theoretical estimates / simulated data.

known_issues: Full 8-eval suite not yet run (2 of 8 completed)
Token savings only visible at 30+ module scale — 8-node fixture too small to demonstrate
